scope: Bounded MPO-/PR3-ANCA, neutrophil activation, complement/C5a and renal/pulmonary small-vessel injury map for GPA/MPA, with a separate EGPA eosinophilic branch. Human observations and experimental models remain distinct; excludes drug-induced disease and comprehensive diagnostic or therapy coverage.

paragraphs.text: Patient MPO-ANCA IgG stimulated human neutrophils to release complement-activating factors in vitro. Supernatants from ANCA-activated neutrophils activated complement in normal serum. C3a did not show the C5a priming effect in the reported assay, limiting a generic anaphylatoxin-priming interpretation.

These selected findings describe a bounded candidate, whose overall explanation has not been independently checked against current literature. Abstract-only inspection; full methods, controls, effect sizes and source-quality appraisal remain unverified. Human culture/serum assay; does not prove whole-disease causation or treatment efficacy. Treatment efficacy has not been synthesized in this summary.
